resources.string: Files up to this size are downloaded as soon as a message comes. When a message is deleted, a file up to 100 MB larger is downloaded then, if the server still gives it. Files saved earlier stay.
These numbers show how the limits work on this device. Link expired means the server no longer gives the file of a deleted message.

In chats and channels whose owner restricted saving content, you can forward, save and copy messages and media and take screenshots, like anywhere else. Telegram does not forward such messages, so they are sent as new messages without the original sender; media not downloaded yet is downloaded first.

A bot\'s messages follow From bots in every chat; other messages follow the kind of chat. A public group or channel is one with a public link. This applies to deleted and edited messages; turning one off stops new saves, what is already kept stays.
